name: Workspace Color
description: Automatically colors VS Code's title bar with a deterministic color derived from the host workspace path, so each project clone is visually distinct.

lightness.description: Color lightness (0-100, clamped to 45 max for text contrast)

targets.description: Comma-separated UI targets: titleBar, statusBar, activityBar

seed.description: Extra string mixed into hash to change the color for a given workspace
